name: Endeavour (STS-118)
about: Endeavour (STS-118) (2007-035A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2007 Aug  8. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2007 Aug 11), held fixed

landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q824383), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory
